summary: Herc Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a routine amendment to its existing receivables financing agreement. The Ninth Amendment, dated August 31, 2026, among Herc Rentals, Herc Receivables U.S. LLC, lenders, and Credit Agricole as administrative agent, increases borrowing commitments and extends the maturity to August 31, 2027. This is an ordinary credit facility amendment, not a special situation. No unusual terms, strategic actions, or board decisions are involved. The filing is routine and does not trigger a special-situations category.
